== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Rendezvous Point]]. One column per published text state, in date order: the printed card, Decipher's errata, and each Players Committee image. The stamp row describes the mark on each image. Yellow highlights mark words changed against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.

Reprints: [[Rendezvous Point (Reflections Foil)]] (12 January 2000) prints the words of the Original column; only notation differs, so it has no column of its own.
